rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for assigning marks to a test or assessing academic performance.

example.english: The teacher will grade according to the answers.
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 wui5 on3 daap3 on3 ping4 fan1

rows.note: Use this specifically when marking or grading students’ test papers.

example.english: I have to stay at school tonight to grade papers.
example.traditional: 我今晚要留喺學校改卷。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 lau4 hai2 hok6 haau6 goi2 gyun2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for marks or scores received in school tests and other evaluations.

example.english: My grade on this test wasn't bad.
example.traditional: 我今次個測驗成績唔錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 go3 cak1 jim6 sing4 zik1 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this for a primary or secondary school year level, such as fifth grade.

example.english: What grade is your son in?
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 zai2 duk6 gan2 gei2 nin4 kap1 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a quality rating or a position on a ranked scale rather than an unranked degree.

example.english: This restaurant is of a really high grade.
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 kap1 sou3 hou2 gou1 wo3

rows.note: Use this for the steepness or gradient of a road, hill, or other passage.

example.english: This road has a pretty steep grade.
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 lou6 ce4 dou6 gei2 daai6 gaa3
